LanguageData.VME_Human_Hive.label: the Unity
LanguageData.VME_Human_Hive.description: The Master's promise survives: mutants and converts joined into one purpose, one army, and one future beyond the weakness of divided humanity.
LanguageData.VME_Egalitarian_Republic.label: NCR civic republic
LanguageData.VME_Egalitarian_Republic.description: Law, representation, civil rights, and public institutions can make the wasteland a nation again, provided corruption and expansion do not consume the republic.
LanguageData.VME_Exalted_Gerontocracy.label: tribal elder council
LanguageData.VME_Exalted_Gerontocracy.description: The oldest survivors carry the memory of every famine, feud, and migration. Their council guards tradition and guides the tribe through hard-won experience.
LanguageData.VME_Factory_Drones.label: Pitt foundry crews
LanguageData.VME_Factory_Drones.description: The furnaces never stop. Labor, discipline, and automation feed an industrial city where every worker is another part of the machine.
LanguageData.VME_Corporate_Overlords.label: RobCo corporate order
LanguageData.VME_Corporate_Overlords.description: Executive authority, automated labor, and relentless profit survived the bombs. The company provides—so long as every asset meets its quota.
LanguageData.VME_GodKing_Radicals.label: Caesar's Legion
LanguageData.VME_GodKing_Radicals.description: Caesar's word is civilization. Conquest, forced assimilation, and absolute loyalty will burn away the weakness of the old world.
LanguageData.VME_Cosmic_Cultists.label: Hubologists
LanguageData.VME_Cosmic_Cultists.description: By cleansing the mind and aligning our neurodynes with cosmic energies, we prepare ourselves for a higher state of being among the stars.
LanguageData.VME_Flame_Seers.label: Bright Brotherhood
LanguageData.VME_Flame_Seers.description: Holy light reveals the path through the wastes. Flame drives back corruption, and the brightest among us will lead the faithful to salvation.
LanguageData.VME_Dwarven_Artificers.label: Pitt forgemasters
LanguageData.VME_Dwarven_Artificers.description: Deep beneath smoke-blackened walls, skilled crews turn ore and scrap into weapons, armor, and the machinery that keeps the foundry alive.
LanguageData.VME_Nordic_Matriarchy.label: wasteland raider matriarchy
LanguageData.VME_Nordic_Matriarchy.description: War-mothers command the bands, divide the spoils, and judge courage. Honor is earned in raids and defended before the whole clan.
LanguageData.VME_Steamworld_Neerdowells.label: Mojave ranch town
LanguageData.VME_Steamworld_Neerdowells.description: Ranchers, caravan hands, settlers, and local law keep a rough frontier town alive between raider country and the long trade roads.
LanguageData.VME_Medieval_Monarchists.label: wasteland feudalists
LanguageData.VME_Medieval_Monarchists.description: Settlements owe tribute and service to the stronghold that protects them. Rank, inheritance, and armed retainers hold this hard new order together.
LanguageData.VME_Pleasure_Extremists.label: New Reno families
LanguageData.VME_Pleasure_Extremists.description: Casinos, chems, vice, and family business rule the city. Pleasure is currency, and every celebration is another chance to make a deal.
LanguageData.VME_Eastern_Revivalists.label: Shi order
LanguageData.VME_Eastern_Revivalists.description: The Shi preserve ancestral discipline while mastering advanced science. Elders and warriors seek harmony between tradition, machine, mind, and nature.
LanguageData.VME_Primitivistic_Nomads.label: Great Khan caravans
LanguageData.VME_Primitivistic_Nomads.description: The clan lives on the road, raiding when it must and carrying chems and trade goods between distant settlements. Strength and freedom belong to the tribe.
LanguageData.VME_Pestilent_Doomsayers.label: atomic doomsayers
LanguageData.VME_Pestilent_Doomsayers.description: Radiation, sickness, pain, and mutation are sacred transformations. Atom's faithful welcome what others fear and prepare for the final division.
LanguageData.VME_Mechanoid_Technocrat.label: Calculator collective
LanguageData.VME_Mechanoid_Technocrat.description: Organic weakness must yield to the precision of the machine intelligence. Scrap, steel, and obedient minds will be joined into a single perfected system.
LanguageData.VME_Ecological_Fascists.label: Treeminder purists
LanguageData.VME_Ecological_Fascists.description: The Treefather and its altered guardians are the future of the living world. Those who poison that future must submit or be rooted out.
LanguageData.VME_Insectoid_Psykers.label: AntAgonizer colony
LanguageData.VME_Insectoid_Psykers.description: Humans broke the world by placing private ambition above survival. The giant ants did the opposite: every worker, soldier, and queen serves the colony. AntAgonizer faithful study their pheromones, tend controlled nests, and organize their own settlement as a single disciplined brood.
